title: Report a winter issue
intro: Tell us about snow, ice or an obstruction in the pilot area. Reports are reviewed by a moderator before anyone sees them, and they expire automatically.

form.locationHelp: Enter the coordinates of the issue, or use your current location.
form.geoDenied: Location permission was denied. Enter coordinates instead.
form.geoUnavailable: Your location isn't available. Enter coordinates instead.
form.consent: I consent to sending this exact location with my report.
form.consentHelp: Required. The location is stored only with your report and deleted when the report is deleted or expires.

validation.coords: Enter a valid latitude and longitude.
validation.outside: This location is outside the pilot area.
validation.consent: You need to consent to sending the location.
validation.tooLong: Keep the description to 280 characters or fewer.

receipt.title: Report received
receipt.body: Thank you. Your report is pending moderation and will not appear on the map until a moderator approves it.
receipt.tokenWarn: Save this code now. It is shown only once and is the only way to delete your report.
receipt.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete the report. It may already have expired or been removed.

status.title: What happens to a report
status.pending: Pending — waiting for a moderator. Not shown to anyone.
status.approved: Approved — shown on the map as an unverified report, never as a confirmed condition.
status.deleted: Deleted — removed by you or a moderator.

expiry: Reports expire 72 hours after submission. All report data is permanently deleted 30 days after a report is rejected, expired or deleted.
rateLimited: You've sent several reports recently. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes before sending another.
rateLimitedNoTime: You've sent several reports recently. Please wait a while before sending another.

admin.title: Moderation
admin.intro: Restricted area. The token is kept in memory for this tab only.
